name: Full Unreleased Characters
author: TPI for the actual characters, Piglix for putting it together and various artists.

firstNightReminder: Show the Scholar every in-play evil character token.
name: Scholar
ability: You start knowing which evil characters are in-play.

firstNightReminder: Show the Auditor the number of players affecting set up.
name: ? Auditor ?
ability: You start knowing how many players have abilities affecting set up. [No default Outsiders]

firstNightReminder: Point to the character type on your character sheet of the closest non-Townsfolk.
name: ? Governess ?
ability: You start knowing one character type of the closest non-Townsfolk (not including Travellers).

firstNightReminder: Point to the minions
name: Diplomat
ability: You start knowing which players are minions. If a minion you know is executed, your team loses, even if dead.

firstNightReminder: Show the Blacksmith the number of in-play outsiders.
name: Blacksmith
ability: You start knowing how many outsiders are in play. All outsiders are drunk, even if you are dead. [+1 Outsider]

firstNightReminder: Show the Ballerina a 1 if there are more townsfolk odd steps away from them clockwise, a 2 if there are more even steps from them clockwise or a 3 if it's equal.
name: Ballerina
ability: You start knowing if more townsfolk are (1) odd or (2) even steps from you clockwise. Or you learn that (3) it's equal.

name: Pirate
ability: You start knowing how many pirates are in-play. If Pirates are the only good characters alive, good wins. [+0 to +2 Pirates]

firstNightReminder: Wake the prophet and get them to show you a number.
otherNightReminder: If it is the day that the prophet chose and all dead players are good, then they are all resurrected as travellers.
name: Prophet
ability: On your 1st night, choose a day number: if all dead players are good that dawn, they are resurrected as travellers.

firstNightReminder: Point to an in-play character
otherNightReminder: Point to an in-play character
name: Stableboy
ability: Each night, learn 1 in-play character.

firstNightReminder: The Moneylender becomes the same alignment as the player that they choose.
otherNightReminder: The Moneylender becomes the same alignment as the player that they choose.
name: Moneylender
ability: Each night, choose an alive player (not yourself): you become their alignment.

firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon and show them that the Palm Reader selected them. Then get them to point to a player. Mark them with the "Dies next night" reminder token. Wake the Palm Reader and point to the player the Demon chose.
otherNightReminder: Wake the Palm Reader and point to the player the Demon chose.
name: Palm Reader
ability: The Demon attacks one night before it takes effect, even if you are dead. Each night, learn who was attacked.

firstNightReminder: Mark a player with the "Drunk & False info" reminder token. Wake the Wench and point to that player.
otherNightReminder: Mark a player with the "Drunk & False info" reminder token. Wake the Wench and point to that player.
name: Wench
ability: Each night, you learn a player. They are drunk until dusk and any information they receive is false.
attribution: Should be 3 Drunk icons. Icon by Dela.

firstNightReminder: Show the Houndskeeper the number of steps to the nearest living player targeted by an evil ability tonight.
otherNightReminder: Show the Houndskeeper the number of steps to the nearest living player targeted by an evil ability tonight.
name: Houndskeeper
ability: Each night, you learn how many steps to the nearest living player targeted by an evil ability tonight.

firstNightReminder: The Genius points to a good character on their sheet. Swap the character token with the Genius token and add the 'Is the Genius' reminder.
otherNightReminder: The Genius points to a good character on their sheet. Swap the character token with the Genius' current token. On every other night, place the 'Drunk' reminder token on the Genius.
name: Genius
ability: Each night, choose a good character: you have that ability until you choose again. You are drunk every other night.

firstNightReminder: Mark the chosen players with the 'Chosen' reminder token. Any abilities that target one, target the other instead.
otherNightReminder: Mark the chosen players with the 'Chosen' reminder token. Any abilities that target one, target the other instead.
name: - Quack -
ability: Each night, choose 2 living players: abilities that target one, target the other instead. The demon cannot die this way.

firstNightReminder: Show the Witch Hunter the alignment of the player who they selected and mark them with the 'Turns evil' reminder token.
otherNightReminder: If the player with the 'Turns evil' reminder token has not been executed, they turn evil. Show the Witch Hunter the alignment of the player who they selected and mark them with the 'Turns evil' reminder token.
name: Witch Hunter
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. If they are not executed tomorrow, they turn evil. You can not be evil.

otherNightReminder: Point to a character that died tonight
name: Insomniac
ability: Each night*, learn a character that died tonight.

otherNightReminder: Get the Voyeur to point to a player. Mark that player with the "Chosen" reminder token. If that player dies tonight, at dawn, announce who the Voyeur is.
name: Voyeur
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): if they die tonight, all players learn who you are.

otherNightReminder: If the Hustler was mad that they were the Hustler mark them with the "False info" reminder token. If the Hustler was nominated today, point to the character of the player that nominated them.
name: Hustler
ability: Each night*, learn the character that nominated you today. If you are "mad" about being the hustler, you receive false info.

name: Astrologer
ability: Each day, ask the Storyteller to tell you 1 piece of false information.

name: ? Matchmaker ?
ability: Each day, privately choose 2 players: you learn if they're connected by an active ability.

name: - Mormon -
ability: Each day, if 1 of your living neighbours publicly agrees, they become a Mormon. If not, lose your ability.

otherNightReminder: If the Druid or the player with the "In the Grove" reminder token dies, if possible, an alive minion dies instead.
name: Druid
ability: Each day, you may publicly choose a player. If either of you die tonight, an alive minion dies instead, if possible.

name: Coachman
ability: Each day, choose a 1 word topic on which the Storyteller tells you 1 fact. If an alive neighbour is evil, you get false info.

firstNightReminder: Show the Thespian and the player with the "Mad" reminder token what they should be mad about.
otherNightReminder: Show the Thespian and the player with the "Mad" reminder token what they should be mad about.
name: Thespian
ability: Each day, an evil player must be "mad" about something or they die. Each day, you must be "mad" about something or you die.

name: Apothecary
ability: Once per game, publicly change one game rule, if the Storyteller agrees.

otherNightReminder: If the Patient should wake, wake them and get them to point to a character. If it is not in-play, shake your head no. If it is, they have that character's ability for each night they were asleep.
name: Patient
ability: Once per game, at night, you wake: choose an in-play character to gain ability for each night you were asleep.

firstNightReminder: Get the Bodyguard to either point to a character or shake their head no. If the Bodyguard points to a character mark them with the "Protected" reminder token.
otherNightReminder: If the Bodyguard has not yet used their ability, get them to either point to a character or shake their head no. If the Bodyguard points to a character mark them with the "Protected" reminder token.
name: Bodyguard
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a character (not the Bodyguard): they are not affected in any way by evil abilities.

name: Hangman
ability: Once per game, choose a player. Going clockwise, good players that do not publicly state their character in 3 seconds, die.

name: Piper
ability: Once per game, publicly choose that from now on: Minions can privately choose to turn good but the next executee's team loses.

name: Machinist
ability: On your 1st day, you may visit the Storyteller to gain the ability of an off-script character, even if drunk or poisoned.

otherNightReminder: If the Leper was killed by the Demon mark them with the 'Poisoned' reminder token.
name: Leper
ability: If the demon kills you, they are poisoned.

name: Phoenix
ability: On final day, if dead, you are raised as a not-in-play townsfolk.

name: Scavenger
ability: If both your neighbors die, something good happens.

name: Nun
ability: Other good players cannot be drunk, poisoned or get false info.

name: Bon Vivant
ability: Your alive neighbouring players are drunk (not including Travelers).

otherNightReminder: If the Nanny died, kill some of the players with both hands over their eyes and mark them with the "Dead" reminder tokens.
name: Nanny
ability: At night, other players with both hands over their eyes cannot die, but if you die, they might die too.

name: Lion Tamer
ability: If either of your alive neighbours died by execution today, all players are safe from the Demon tonight.

firstNightReminder: If a player turns evil, show them the Schoolmarm token. If they nod yes, signal to them that they are good, if they shake no, send them back to sleep.
otherNightReminder: If a player turns evil, show them the Schoolmarm token. If they nod yes, signal to them that they are good, if they shake no, send them back to sleep.
name: Schoolmarm
ability: Players who turn evil learn you are in play and may choose to remain good. [1 evil-creating character is in-play]

otherNightReminder: If the Strongman was the most mad about being the Strongman today, if a player chooses them for any reason tonight, they die.
name: Strongman
ability: If you were the most mad about being the Strongman today & a player chose you tonight for any reason, they die.

otherNightReminder: If the Messenger used their ability, wake the chosen player and show them the Messenger's message.
name: Messenger
ability: On the final night, even if you are dead, choose a player: they learn something. At any time, you may request what.

name: ? Prince ?
ability: After the first night, as long as you haven't been nominated, you cannot die, turn evil, or become another character.

name: - Rogue -
ability: You may choose to break any rules when alive. If the Storyteller finds out, even if dead, something bad might happen.

otherNightReminder: Choose whether or not to make a player the Tycoon shook hands with drunk. Wake the Tycoon and nod yes if they shook hands with an evil player, otherwise shake your head no.
name: Tycoon
ability: 1 player that you have shaken hands with might be drunk. Each night*, learn if you shook hands with an evil player today.

name: Merchant
ability: You & any other player may choose to make a deal. Until a new deal is made, if a player breaks the deal, 1 of you dies.

firstNightReminder: If both of the Queen's neighbours are good wake them and show them the 'This character selected you' card and then the Queen token
name: Queen
ability: If both of your neighbours are good, they learn who you are. Anyone mad about a Queen being in-play might be executed.

firstNightReminder: Wake the Mole and show them the minion they are.
name: Mole
ability: You are a minion & register as evil. If the Demon publicly guesses you (once), your team loses, even if dead, drunk or poisoned.

name: Beekeeper
ability: One evil player registers as good and as a Townsfolk or Outsider. If you publicly guess who it is (once per game), your team wins.

firstNightReminder: The Casanova points to a player. Mark them with the "Chosen" reminder token.
otherNightReminder: The Casanova points to a player. Mark them with the "Chosen" reminder token.
name: Casanova
ability: Each night, choose an alive player (not yourself). If they're an ally & executed tomorrow your team loses.

name: Bully
ability: Any players who vote differently to you might die.

name: - Peasant -
ability: If you lose, you are the Peasant in the next game.

otherNightReminder: If the Dowager died today, wake the Demon and show them the Grimoire.
name: ? Dowager ?
ability: If you died today or tonight, the Demon sees the Grimoire.
attribution: Should be a hat with veil and a hand holding a cigarette

name: ? Orphan ?
ability: If you are good & dead, the Demon only dies by execution if you voted.

name: Tramp
ability: If there are any votes to execute you, you might be executed immediately.

otherNightReminder: The Chartalan becomes the alignment of the 1st player to be executed.
name: Charlatan
ability: At night, you become the alignment of the 1st player to be executed this game.
attribution: Should be two faces, a light one and a dark one

name: Donkey Wrangler
ability: If you are nominated and the demon is not executed, your team loses. [Your token is square]

otherNightReminder: Wake the first player to nominate the Golden Child and show them that they are now evil.
name: Golden Child
ability: The 1st player to nominate you, turns evil that night. If you nominate yourself 1st, your team loses.

name: Hermit
ability: You have the ability of every other outsider. No Outsider modification effects work. [No other outsiders]

name: Princess
ability: If a player dies, then claims to be the Princess (you must), 1 player may choose to die instead. If they are evil, your team loses.

firstNightReminder: Show the Prisoner a not-in-play character.
name: Prisoner
ability: You cannot vote. You start knowing 1 not-in-play character. If most players vote to free you, you become that character and that character's alignment.

firstNightReminder: The Vat Dweller points to an Outsider. All Outsiders become that Outsider.
name: Vat Dweller
ability: On your 1st night, choose an Outsider. Every Outsider is a copy of that Outsider. [-? to +? Outsiders]

firstNightReminder: The Klaun points to up to 3 players. Wake those players and show them that they are mad in some way.
otherNightReminder: The Klaun points to up to 3 players. Mark them with the "Fake Madness" reminder tokens. Wake those players and show them that they are mad in some way.
name: Klaun
ability: Each night, choose up to 3 players. They are told that they are mad in some way, but are not.
attribution: Should be a spotty hat with flowers

otherNightReminder: Wake the Familiar at the same time as the Demon and get them to point to a player. That player dies.
name: Familiar
ability: Each night*, you wake with the Demon and choose a player: they die. If you die, the demon loses its ability.

firstNightReminder: If the Ringmaster nods 'yes' they become the Storyteller (mark them with 'Is the Storyteller' and 'No ability'). If they shake 'no' put them back to sleep.
otherNightReminder: If the Ringmaster nods 'yes' they become the Storyteller (mark them with 'Is the Storyteller' and 'No ability'). If they shake 'no' put them back to sleep.
name: Ringmaster
ability: Once per game, choose to become the Storyteller. You may still vote.

name: Wizard
ability: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, your wish may have a price, and leaves a clue to its nature.

name: Amaniti
ability: Your neighbours falsely register to good players' abilities.

name: Senator
ability: Players can only nominate their living neighbors, even if you are dead.

name: Scarecrow
ability: To good players, you register as a Demon & the Demon registers as a Minion.

name: Wraith
ability: You may choose to open your eyes at night. You wake when other evil players do.

otherNightReminder: Mark the 1st in-play character that the Imposter was mad about yesterday with the "Has ability" and "Poisoned" reminder tokens.
name: Imposter
ability: You poison and gain the ability of the 1st in-play character that you are mad about being each day.

firstNightReminder: The Copycat points to a Minion player or character. Mark them with the 'Has ability' reminder token.
otherNightReminder: The Copycat points to a Minion player or character. Mark them with the 'Has ability' reminder token.
name: Copycat
ability: You have the ability of an in-play Minion. If no others exist, you start by choosing a Minion: gain their ability.

name: Riddle Fiend
ability: On the final day, even if you are dead, each player publicly guesses who you are. If no good players do, evil wins.

firstNightReminder: The Gorgon points to a player, mark them with the "Petrified" reminder token. If they leave their seat tomorrow, they die.
otherNightReminder: If there are 4 or more players alive: The Gorgon points to a player, mark them with the "Petrified" reminder token. If they leave their seat tomorrow, they die.
name: ? Gorgon ?
ability: Each night, choose a player: if they leave their seat tomorrow, they die. Lose this ability when 3 or fewer players live.

name: Daughter of Nox
ability: Good’s info is reversed. The 1st time each player names you: lose your ability (if they are good), regain it (if they are evil).

name: Sicilian
ability: When nominations are called, if you publicly choose a player (not yourself) & they are not executed today, their team wins.
flavor: You must take your opponent into a deep dark forest where 2+2=5, and the path leading out is only wide enough for one.

firstNightReminder: Show the Zodion every not-in-play character token.
otherNightReminder: Put the 'Dead' reminder token next to the living character that is highest on the script.
name: Zodion
ability: You start knowing all not-in-play characters. Each night*, the highest character on the script dies.

firstNightReminder: Mark the players the Shacklewight point at with the 'Bound' reminder token. Then, wake those players and show them the 'This character selected you' card and the Shacklewight token
otherNightReminder: Remove the previous 'Bound' reminder tokens. Mark the players the Shacklewight point at with the 'Bound' reminder token. Then, wake those players and show them the 'This character selected you' card and the Shacklewight token
name: Shacklewight
ability: Each night, choose any players: they all wake together. Tomorrow day, if 1 dies, they all die. Each day, if no-one dies, evil wins.

firstNightReminder: The Virilus points to a player. Mark them with the 'Infected' reminder token.
otherNightReminder: The Virilus points to a player. Mark them with the 'Infected' reminder token.
name: Virilus
ability: Each night, choose a player to infect. Infected who nominate die & infect the nominee. After day 4, evil wins.
attribution: Should be some sort of bubbly virus

otherNightReminder: The Soul Hammer points to a player. That player dies.
name: Soul Hammer
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. After the final night, the dead may not talk to the living.

otherNightReminder: If the Creeping Terror points at up to 3 players, mark them with the 'Marked' reminder token. Then, wake them and tell them that the Creeping Terror has selected them. If Creeping Terror nods then kill all marked players.
name: Creeping Terror
ability: Each night*, mark up to 3 players or kill all marked players. Marked players learn that they are marked.

otherNightReminder: The Barrow-Fog points to a player. That player dies but will register as alive during the day.
name: - Barrow-Fog -
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Players killed by the Barrow-Fog register as alive during the day.

otherNightReminder: Kill a player for each alive good player who raised their hand at dusk.
name: Palabra de Dios
ability: Each night*, each alive good player that raised a hand at dusk, kills a random player. If none did, evil wins.
attribution: Should be some sort of long thin horns

otherNightReminder: If a new Le Cadeau was made today, wake them and show them the "You are" card and the Le Cadeau token. The original Demon dies. Otherwise, the Le Cadeau points to a player, they die.
name: ? Le Cadeau ?
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Townsfolk to nominate you becomes an evil Le Cadeau & you die tonight.

otherNightReminder: The Queen of Lies will point to 3 players. Mark them with the "Duped" reminder tokens. Publicly announce the players marked "Duped". Wake them one by one and get them to choose a player. Mark those players with the "Chosen" reminder tokens. Kill 2 of the "Chosen" players and mark them with the "Dead" reminder tokens.
name: Queen of Lies
ability: Each night* choose 3 players to dupe: each chooses a different alive player, 2 of which die. All players learn who you duped.

otherNightReminder: Dolomite may lose their ability. If not, Dolomite points to a player: that player turns evil.
name: Dolomite
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they turn evil & learn who you are. Once per game, you lose this ability. [No Minions]

otherNightReminder: A player dies. On the final night, the Tipi-Tipi will choose a player, mark them with the "Mad" reminder token. Wake them and show them the Tipi-Tipi token and then point to the Tipi-Tipi.
name: Tipi-Tipi
ability: Each night*, a player dies. On the final night, choose a player. They are "mad" that you are not the demon or their team loses.

otherNightReminder: The Hwisp points to a player. That player dies.
name: Hwisp
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If nominated by a Townsfolk, you die. 2nd Townsfolk to nominate in a day's, team loses.

firstNightReminder: Wake the good player with the "Knows" reminder token and point to the two players with the "Known" reminder tokens.
otherNightReminder: The J'Nak points to a player. That player dies.
name: J'nak
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. 1 good player knows you are 1 of 2 players. If executed while a minion lives, your team wins.

otherNightReminder: The Skinkulus points to a player. That player dies. If all player the Skinkulus has killed differ in gender from the Skinkulus wake them and show them that they are evil.
name: - Skinkulus -
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If all differ in gender to you they turn evil & may not vote (even if you lose this ability).

otherNightReminder: The Fanzazz points to a player. They die and the Fanzazz becomes the alignment of that player.
name: Fanzazz
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die & you become their alignment. If you die, your team loses. If only 2 players live, your team wins.
All players start dead. Dead players may nominate and if executed, are reborn. Each night*, choose a player: they are reborn. If all evils live, evil wins.

otherNightReminder: If all Minions are dead wake the Sissaphyth and get the to point to a Demon. Mark them with the "Acts twice" reminder token and they become that Demon.
name: Sissaphyth
ability: At night, if all Minions are dead, choose a Demon: become it, acting twice each night.

name: - Deus Ex Fiasco -
ability: Once per game, the Storyteller will make a mistake, correct it, and publicly admit to it.

name: Hindu
ability: The player who dies first may secretly choose which character they are in the next game.

name: - Patron -
ability: Jinxed characters may not both be in-play. Evil players know which not-in-play characters are jinxed.
